about.subtitle: Our Story
about.title: Who Am I
about.intro: I am a software developer with a deep background in the React and JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem, specializing in building complex web and desktop applications.
about.bio: I have extensive experience in customizing and extending large-scale enterprise codebases (like the Mattermost open-source project), which involves working heavily with React, TypeScript, Go, and advanced styling architectures. I strictly follow a "Zero-Bug" policy, ensuring every piece of code is modular, robust, and optimized for maximum performance.
about.personalTouchBio: Beyond software engineering, I have a deep interest in gemology, specifically identifying and evaluating rare types of Yemeni Agate.

projects.subtitle: Portfolio
projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.intro: A selection of my most challenging and impactful engineering projects.

project1.title: Mattermost
project1.description: A customized, highly optimized workspace platform based on the Mattermost open-source project. This required deep architectural changes, frontend rebranding, and optimizing plugins using Mattermost's core languages: React, TypeScript, Go, and custom CSS.

project2.title: WiFi Share Pro
project2.description: An Electron.js desktop application designed to circumvent strict EDR (SentinelOne) network policies and share internet securely on restricted Windows systems.

project3.title: High-Performance Remote Control System
project3.description: Engineered a solution for screen freezing during remote sessions by migrating to 'uiohook-napi' and implementing an asynchronous event coalescing strategy with non-blocking queues.
